en: Then the end of those who did evil was the worst [consequence] because they denied the signs of Allah and used to ridicule them.
ar: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَـٰٓـُٔواْ ٱلسُّوٓأَىٰٓ أَن كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَكَانُواْ بِهَا يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ

nb.en: Have they not traveled through the earth and observed how was the end of those before them? They were greater than them in power, and they plowed the earth and built it up more than they have built it up, and their messengers came to them with clear evidences. And Allah would not ever have wronged them, but they were wronging themselves.

tr: Thumma kana AAaqibata allatheena asaoo alssooa an kaththaboo biayati Allahi wakanoo biha yastahzioona

en: Indeed they, when it was said to them, "There is no deity but Allah," were arrogant
ar: إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوٓاْ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ

nb.en: Indeed, that is how We deal with the criminals.

tr: Innahum kanoo itha qeela lahum la ilaha illa Allahu yastakbiroona

en: Nor is there to Him any equivalent."
ar: وَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدُۢ

nb.en: He neither begets nor is born,

tr: Walam yakun lahu kufuwan ahadun

en: For them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant
ar: لَّيۡسَ لَهُمۡ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٖ

nb.en: They will be given drink from a boiling spring.

tr: Laysa lahum taAAamun illa min dareeAAin

en: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position],
ar: ذِي قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِي ٱلۡعَرۡشِ مَكِينٖ

nb.en: [That] indeed, the Qur'an is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger

tr: Thee quwwatin AAinda thee alAAarshi makeenin

en: The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth. That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves].
ar: يَوۡمَ يَسۡمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيۡحَةَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡخُرُوجِ

nb.en: And listen on the Day when the Caller will call out from a place that is near -

tr: Yawma yasmaAAoona alssayhata bialhaqqi thalika yawmu alkhurooji

en: But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered
ar: ۞أَفَلَا يَعۡلَمُ إِذَا بُعۡثِرَ مَا فِي ٱلۡقُبُورِ

nb.en: And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.

tr: Afala yaAAlamu itha buAAthira ma fee alquboori

en: Then the companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?
ar: فَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَيۡمَنَةِ مَآ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَيۡمَنَةِ

nb.en: And you become [of] three kinds:

tr: Faashabu almaymanati ma ashabu almaymanati

en: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."
ar: وَإِذَا رَأَوۡهُمۡ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ

nb.en: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.

tr: Waitha raawhum qaloo inna haolai ladalloona

en: Indeed, those who disbelieve in the message after it has come to them... And indeed, it is a mighty Book.
ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِٱلذِّكۡرِ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡۖ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَكِتَٰبٌ عَزِيزٞ

nb.en: Indeed, those who inject deviation into Our verses are not concealed from Us. So, is he who is cast into the Fire better or he who comes secure on the Day of Resurrection? Do whatever you will; indeed, He is Seeing of what you do.

tr: Inna allatheena kafaroo bialththikri lamma jaahum wainnahu lakitabun AAazeezun

en: And to Him belong the ships [with sails] elevated in the sea like mountains.
ar: وَلَهُ ٱلۡجَوَارِ ٱلۡمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ كَٱلۡأَعۡلَٰمِ

nb.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tr: Walahu aljawari almunshaatu fee albahri kaalaAAlami

en: So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.
ar: فَمَهِّلِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ أَمۡهِلۡهُمۡ رُوَيۡدَۢا

nb.en: But I am planning a plan.

tr: Famahhili alkafireena amhilhum ruwaydan

en: But when he gave them from His bounty, they were stingy with it and turned away while they refused.
ar: فَلَمَّآ ءَاتَىٰهُم مِّن فَضۡلِهِۦ بَخِلُواْ بِهِۦ وَتَوَلَّواْ وَّهُم مُّعۡرِضُونَ

nb.en: And among them are those who made a covenant with Allah, [saying], "If He should give us from His bounty, we will surely spend in charity, and we will surely be among the righteous."

tr: Falamma atahum min fadlihi bakhiloo bihi watawallaw wahum muAAridoona

en: That is the command of Allah, which He has sent down to you; and whoever fears Allah - He will remove for him his misdeeds and make great for him his reward.
ar: ذَٰلِكَ أَمۡرُ ٱللَّهِ أَنزَلَهُۥٓ إِلَيۡكُمۡۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يُكَفِّرۡ عَنۡهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِۦ وَيُعۡظِمۡ لَهُۥٓ أَجۡرًا

nb.en: And those who no longer expect menstruation among your women - if you doubt, then their period is three months, and [also for] those who have not menstruated. And for those who are pregnant, their term is until they give birth. And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him of his matter ease.

tr: Thalika amru Allahi anzalahu ilaykum waman yattaqi Allaha yukaffir AAanhu sayyiatihi wayuAAthim lahu ajran

en: And prevention will be placed between them and what they desire, as was done with their kind before. Indeed, they were in disquieting denial.
ar: وَحِيلَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ وَبَيۡنَ مَا يَشۡتَهُونَ كَمَا فُعِلَ بِأَشۡيَاعِهِم مِّن قَبۡلُۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ فِي شَكّٖ مُّرِيبِۭ

nb.en: And they had already disbelieved in it before and would assault the unseen from a place far away.

tr: Waheela baynahum wabayna ma yashtahoona kama fuAAila biashyaAAihim min qablu innahum kanoo fee shakkin mureebin

en: Then what is [the matter] with them that they are, from the reminder, turning away
ar: فَمَا لَهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلتَّذۡكِرَةِ مُعۡرِضِينَ

nb.en: So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors.

tr: Fama lahum AAani alttathkirati muAArideena

en: Then is he who knows that what has been revealed to you from your Lord is the truth like one who is blind? They will only be reminded who are people of understanding -
ar: ۞أَفَمَن يَعۡلَمُ أَنَّمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ ٱلۡحَقُّ كَمَنۡ هُوَ أَعۡمَىٰٓۚ إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ

nb.en: For those who have responded to their Lord is the best [reward], but those who did not respond to Him - if they had all that is in the earth entirely and the like of it with it, they would [attempt to] ransom themselves thereby. Those will have the worst account, and their refuge is Hell, and wretched is the resting place.

tr: Afaman yaAAlamu annama onzila ilayka min rabbika alhaqqu kaman huwa aAAma innama yatathakkaru oloo alalbabi

en: And they were not commanded except to worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion, inclining to truth, and to establish prayer and to give zakah. And that is the correct religion.
ar: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓاْ إِلَّا لِيَعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤۡتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلۡقَيِّمَةِ

nb.en: Nor did those who were given the Scripture become divided until after there had come to them clear evidence.

tr: Wama omiroo illa liyaAAbudoo Allaha mukhliseena lahu alddeena hunafaa wayuqeemoo alssalata wayutoo alzzakata wathalika deenu alqayyimati

en: May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.
ar: تَبَّتۡ يَدَآ أَبِي لَهَبٖ وَتَبَّ

nb.en: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained.

tr: Tabbat yada abee lahabin watabba

en: And brought [within view], that Day, is Hell - that Day, man will remember, but what good to him will be the remembrance?
ar: وَجِاْيٓءَ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بِجَهَنَّمَۚ يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ

nb.en: And your Lord has come and the angels, rank upon rank,

tr: Wajeea yawmaithin bijahannama yawmaithin yatathakkaru alinsanu waanna lahu alththikra

en: But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them].
ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمۡدَمَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمۡ فَسَوَّىٰهَا

nb.en: And the messenger of Allah [Salih] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allah or [prevent her from] her drink."

tr: Fakaththaboohu faAAaqarooha fadamdama AAalayhim rabbuhum bithanbihim fasawwaha

en: So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship].
ar: فَإِذَا فَرَغۡتَ فَٱنصَبۡ

nb.en: Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.

tr: Faitha faraghta fainsab

en: It will be, on the Day they see it, as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.
ar: كَأَنَّهُمۡ يَوۡمَ يَرَوۡنَهَا لَمۡ يَلۡبَثُوٓاْ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوۡ ضُحَىٰهَا

nb.en: You are only a warner for those who fear it.

tr: Kaannahum yawma yarawnaha lam yalbathoo illa AAashiyyatan aw duhaha

en: And from the evil of an envier when he envies."
ar: وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ

nb.en: And from the evil of the blowers in knots

tr: Wamin sharri hasidin itha hasada

en: Have you not considered those who left their homes in many thousands, fearing death? Allah said to them, "Die"; then He restored them to life. And Allah is full of bounty to the people, but most of the people do not show gratitude.
ar: ۞أَلَمۡ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ خَرَجُواْ مِن دِيَٰرِهِمۡ وَهُمۡ أُلُوفٌ حَذَرَ ٱلۡمَوۡتِ فَقَالَ لَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ مُوتُواْ ثُمَّ أَحۡيَٰهُمۡۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَذُو فَضۡلٍ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَشۡكُرُونَ

nb.en: Thus does Allah make clear to you His verses that you might use reason.

tr: Alam tara ila allatheena kharajoo min diyarihim wahum oloofun hathara almawti faqala lahumu Allahu mootoo thumma ahyahum inna Allaha lathoo fadlin AAala alnnasi walakinna akthara alnnasi la yashkuroona

en: And every soul will be fully compensated [for] what it did; and He is most knowing of what they do.
ar: وَوُفِّيَتۡ كُلُّ نَفۡسٖ مَّا عَمِلَتۡ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَفۡعَلُونَ

nb.en: And the earth will shine with the light of its Lord, and the record [of deeds] will be placed, and the prophets and the witnesses will be brought, and it will be judged between them in truth, and they will not be wronged.

tr: Wawuffiyat kullu nafsin ma AAamilat wahuwa aAAlamu bima yafAAaloona

en: And [to] others of them who have not yet joined them. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
ar: وَءَاخَرِينَ مِنۡهُمۡ لَمَّا يَلۡحَقُواْ بِهِمۡۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ

nb.en: It is He who has sent among the unlettered a Messenger from themselves reciting to them His verses and purifying them and teaching them the Book and wisdom - although they were before in clear error -

tr: Waakhareena minhum lamma yalhaqoo bihim wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu

en: And they urge you to hasten the punishment. And if not for [the decree of] a specified term, punishment would have reached them. But it will surely come to them suddenly while they perceive not.
ar: وَيَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَكَ بِٱلۡعَذَابِ وَلَوۡلَآ أَجَلٞ مُّسَمّٗى لَّجَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُۚ وَلَيَأۡتِيَنَّهُم بَغۡتَةٗ وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ

nb.en: Say, "Sufficient is Allah between me and you as Witness. He knows what is in the heavens and earth. And they who have believed in falsehood and disbelieved in Allah - it is those who are the losers."

tr: WayastaAAjiloonaka bialAAathabi walawla ajalun musamman lajaahumu alAAathabu walayatiyannahum baghtatan wahum la yashAAuroona

en: And if each soul that wronged had everything on earth, it would offer it in ransom. And they will confide regret when they see the punishment; and they will be judged in justice, and they will not be wronged
ar: وَلَوۡ أَنَّ لِكُلِّ نَفۡسٖ ظَلَمَتۡ مَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ لَٱفۡتَدَتۡ بِهِۦۗ وَأَسَرُّواْ ٱلنَّدَامَةَ لَمَّا رَأَوُاْ ٱلۡعَذَابَۖ وَقُضِيَ بَيۡنَهُم بِٱلۡقِسۡطِ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُونَ

nb.en: And they ask information of you, [O Muhammad], "Is it true?" Say, "Yes, by my Lord. Indeed, it is truth; and you will not cause failure [to Allah]."

tr: Walaw anna likulli nafsin thalamat ma fee alardi laiftadat bihi waasarroo alnnadamata lamma raawoo alAAathaba waqudiya baynahum bialqisti wahum la yuthlamoona

en: And they said, "Why was this Qur'an not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities?"
ar: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡلَا نُزِّلَ هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانُ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡقَرۡيَتَيۡنِ عَظِيمٍ

nb.en: But when the truth came to them, they said, "This is magic, and indeed we are, concerning it, disbelievers."

tr: Waqaloo lawla nuzzila hatha alquranu AAala rajulin mina alqaryatayni AAatheemun
